prompt: Use the three attached production-model reference sheets as the authoritative visual guide for a single static full-body Kantus from GEARS TACTICS (2020), not a generic Kantus or a costume from another Gears edition. These are Ji Ruan's published Gears Tactics final character renders. Create one clean isolated game-asset reference render, with actual transparent alpha background. Exactly one Kantus, one pose, no duplicates or turnaround grid. Full silhouette from the tall crested helmet to every clawed toe and robe hem visible, generous clear padding around all extremities. Tall portrait composition. Standing calm battle-ready idle pose, body and face oriented toward screen RIGHT in a three-quarter side view, feet grounded, both arms separated enough to read the silhouette, hands empty and relaxed. Preserve the Tactics model's tall slender-but-muscular anatomy, elongated crested burgundy/brown helmet with tarnished brass trim and small central gold emblem, pale gray-purple craggy skin, orange-red eyes, exposed interlocking uneven ivory teeth, bony knobbled shoulder anatomy, two metal chest rings and buckles, black-gray wrappings on forearms, narrow waist, layered dark leathery robe and hanging panels with gold-brass borders, worn distressed hem, digitigrade-looking legs and large dark clawed feet. Use the front, three-quarter and side reference views to preserve costume construction and proportions; do not invent extra armor, weapons, glowing effects, spikes, insignia, or new color schemes. Render faithful dark realistic materials in clear neutral studio lighting with readable local detail, not theatrical shadows. No scene, floor, contact shadow outside the subject, text, watermark, logo, border, UI, labels, character name, card, or animation. The deliverable is a high-detail still candidate for manual fidelity review, not a claim of exact asset reproduction.
